newsitem.title: USA: YEAREND-Race for deepwater oil in US Gulf quickens.
newsitem.headline: YEAREND-Race for deepwater oil in US Gulf quickens.

text.p: The race to explore for oil and natural gas accelerated this year in deepwater fields in the Gulf of Mexico, where producers see a resurgence in production in the years ahead.
Oil companies shattered records in federal lease sales and projected steady increases in future production from the Gulf, once declared all but dead as an area for domestic drilling.
"People have been trying to write off the Gulf coast as dead for the last 30 years," said William Fisher of the University of Texas at Austin's Bureau of Economic Geology.
